FN-NRHG98T-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 70
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 70 as introduced could increase the receipts to the Board of Cosmetology and
Barbering Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of people that seek
licensure as an esthetician/makeup artist license and the examination and license fee amounts,
set by the board.
